reviews.text: The Samsung Galaxy Book3 is a sleek laptop with a beautiful 1920x1080 display that looks great for streaming movies. However, the battery life struggles to last more than five hours when I am editing videos with the 12th Gen Intel i5 processor. The keyboard is comfortable to type on, but the trackpad feels a bit too small for my large hands. At this price point, I expected better build quality and more USB-C ports for my peripherals. Overall, it is a decent machine for students, though the Windows 11 experience feels a bit sluggish on the 8GB of RAM.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 looks sleek and the 15.6-inch display is incredibly bright for outdoor use. However, the battery drains surprisingly fast when running heavy tasks like video editing. I wish it had more ports since the USB-C only support requires dongles for my peripherals. The keyboard feels solid and the trackpad is responsive enough for daily work. For the price, it is an average laptop with decent performance but nothing exceptional.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 feels incredibly light and portable, making it perfect for my daily commute. With the 13th Gen Intel Core i5 and 16GB of RAM, it handles multitasking with impressive speed. Unfortunately, the battery life struggles to last more than five hours when streaming video at full brightness. The display is sharp, though I wish it were a bit brighter for outdoor use. Overall, it is a solid machine for the price, even if the keyboard lacks a bit of tactile feedback.
